standard_features.title: CSA-approved electrical panel
standard_features.text: Every machine ships with a CSA-approved panel, wired for Canadian voltage.

standard_features.title: Parts and support in Canada
standard_features.text: Spare parts and technical support readily available from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

standard_features.title: 7-day money-back guarantee
standard_features.text: Try the machine in your shop — full refund within 7 days on in-stock models.

standard_features.title: 1-year warranty
standard_features.text: On every new machine we sell, with parts and service from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

standard_features.title: Made in Turkey with European components
standard_features.text: GMS has built rebar machinery in Ankara since 1960 and makes its own gears in-house.

standard_features.title: Installation and training
standard_features.text: Our technicians commission the machine and train your operators, anywhere in Canada — on request, at an additional charge.

standard_features.title: Remote troubleshooting by video call
standard_features.text: Our technicians diagnose faults and guide your operator through the fix over a video call.

standard_features.title: Shipping across Canada and the US from Ontario
standard_features.text: From our warehouse in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, we deliver to every province and territory and export to customers anywhere in the United States — freight arranged by NovoTech at competitive rates.

standard_features.title: Financing with 0% down
standard_features.text: Lease or finance the machine with 0% down and competitive rates through our financing partners — keep your cash working in the shop.

standard_features.title: Order today with 10% down
standard_features.text: Simple payment terms: 10% down payment to place your order, the remaining 90% before shipping from our warehouse in Mississauga, ON, Canada.

standard_features.title: 5% off your second machine
standard_features.text: Returning customers get 5% off their next machine from NovoTech — our thank-you for coming back.

voltage_note: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase available on request.
steel_note: Capacities are the manufacturer's ratings for one or more bars at once in steel of 45, 65 and 85 kg/mm² tensile strength (≈ 64,000, 92,500 and 120,900 psi). For Canadian Grade 400W rebar (minimum tensile strength 540 MPa ≈ 55 kg/mm²) use the 65 kg/mm² column as a conservative guide. Bar-size equivalents (Canadian metric bars and US bar numbers) are given for the single-bar capacity.

agents.title: Sales agents wanted across Canada
agents.kicker: Represent NovoTech in your city or province
agents.text: NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada — British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario outside the GTA, Quebec and Atlantic Canada. If you already call on steel fabricators, rebar shops, precast plants, HVAC shops or contractors, add a proven line of GMS, Dener and other metalworking machinery to what you offer.
points: Open to individuals and companies with customers in metal fabrication or construction
Quotations, brochures, videos and demonstrations prepared by NovoTech for your customers
Installation, operator training, spare parts and technical support stay with NovoTech in Mississauga, ON, Canada
